name: Abu Dhabi Aviation
meta_description: Abu Dhabi Aviation (ADA) is the named eVTOL operating partner under Archer Aviation's UAE Launch Edition definitive agreement. Group CEO Mahmood Al Hameli. First Launch Edition payments flowing Nov 2025.

name: Abu Dhabi Cruise Terminal Hybrid Heliport
meta_description: GCAA design approval announced 23 April 2025. UAE's first hybrid heliport, converting an existing helipad to dual heliport/vertiport use. Partnership between Archer Aviation, Falcon Aviation Services, and Abu Dhabi Aviation.

name: Abu Dhabi Department of Municipalities and Transport (DMT)
meta_description: Abu Dhabi DMT, established by Law No. 30 of 2019, oversees urban planning and transport in the emirate via affiliates including Abu Dhabi Mobility (ITC).

name: Abu Dhabi Network — Route 1 (Abu Dhabi ↔ Dubai)
meta_description: Archer Aviation and Falcon Aviation plan Abu Dhabi to Dubai eVTOL route: Marina Mall heliport (Corniche) to Falcon Heliport at Atlantis the Palm, ~30 minutes.

name: Abu Dhabi Network — Route 2
meta_description: Abu Dhabi Network Route 2 is the second corridor in the emirate 10+ vertiport plan. Endpoints not yet published; AUH and AZI confirmed as first anchors.

name: Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO)
meta_description: The Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) is the strategic government counterparty for Archer Aviation's UAE Launch Edition. Director General Badr Al-Olama. Framework agreement signed 25 April 2024 at DRIFTx.

name: Al Bateen Executive Airport (AZI) Vertiport
meta_description: Al Bateen Executive Airport (AZI) Vertiport is under construction as the second foundational node of Abu Dhabi's 10-vertiport network. Site of Archer Midnight's first Abu Dhabi flight on 2 July 2025.

name: Al Maktoum International Airport Vertiport (DWC)
meta_description: Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC) was the landing site of the UAE's first piloted eVTOL flight on 9 November 2025. A formal vertiport is not confirmed by primary sources.

name: American University of Dubai Vertiport
meta_description: American University of Dubai Vertiport, announced 17 November 2025 by Joby and the RTA. Wasl Asset Management Group is the property partner. Launching 2026.

name: Archer Aviation — Abu Dhabi
meta_description: Archer Aviation's Abu Dhabi launch programme: Midnight eVTOL, ADIO and Abu Dhabi Aviation partnership, vertiport network, GCAA certification status.

name: Archer Midnight (Abu Dhabi)
meta_description: Archer Aviation Midnight in Abu Dhabi: first UAE flight 2 July 2025 at Al Bateen, full eVTOL envelope completed November 2025 with Abu Dhabi Aviation.

name: Archer Midnight — UAE Launch Edition Flight Test Campaign
meta_description: Archer Aviation's Midnight eVTOL completed in-country UAE flight test campaign culminating 14 November 2025. Full-envelope desert testing as part of the Launch Edition program with Abu Dhabi Aviation.

name: Atlantis The Royal Vertiport
meta_description: Atlantis The Royal Vertiport, Palm Jumeirah node of Dubai's eVTOL network announced 17 November 2025. Joby Aviation, RTA, Skyports - status and sources.

name: Did Not Make The Cut: 13 Entities We Cut
meta_description: We cut 13 candidate eVTOL entities from the Arab-world database because they failed our contracted/built/flight-tested/regulated bar. Honest disclosure of what was considered and rejected, with primary sources.

name: Dubai Future Foundation
meta_description: Dubai Future Foundation: Dubai Government's foresight authority. Convening role on eVTOL via Dubai Self-Driving Strategy, drone programme, accelerator cohorts.

name: Dubai Mall Vertiport
meta_description: Dubai Mall Vertiport, announced 17 November 2025 by Joby and the RTA, with Emaar Properties as the property partner. Construction set to begin in 2026.

name: Dubai Marina Vertiport
meta_description: Dubai Marina Vertiport is the second node of Dubai's eVTOL network. Confirmed under construction by Skyports Infrastructure as of 16 April 2026, under Joby Aviation's exclusive RTA agreement.

name: DXB ↔ Dubai Mall
meta_description: Joby Aviation route between DXB and Dubai Mall vertiports, planned for 2026 commercial launch under exclusive RTA agreement. Primary sources verified.

name: DXB ↔ Atlantis The Royal
meta_description: Joby Aviation route between DXB and Atlantis The Royal vertiport, Palm Jumeirah: ~10-minute flight planned for 2026 launch under RTA exclusive agreement.

name: DXB Vertiport
meta_description: DXB Vertiport (registered VDX) received UAE GCAA certification on 7 July 2026 — the world's first purpose-built commercial vertiport, developed by Skyports Infrastructure at Dubai International Airport. Certified for eVTOL operations; Joby Aviation passenger service pending launch.

name: EHang EH216-S Mecca Hajj Flight
meta_description: The EHang EH216-S pilotless eVTOL completed its debut flight in Saudi Arabia on 12 June 2024 during the Hajj season in Mecca. First autonomous eVTOL passenger trial in the Kingdom.

name: EHang EH216-S (UAE)
meta_description: EHang EH216-S in the UAE: completed the Middle East's first passenger-carrying pilotless eVTOL demo flight in Abu Dhabi on 6 May 2024. Specs and milestones.

name: General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA), Saudi Arabia
meta_description: GACA published the Advanced Air Mobility Roadmap in January 2024. Issued Special Flight Authorization for Volocopter NEOM flight 21 June 2023. Signed MoUs with Lilium, Joby, Archer.

name: General Civil Aviation Authority — UAE
meta_description: GCAA UAE is the federal civil aviation regulator overseeing eVTOL type certification, vertiport regulations and Air Operator Certificates in the UAE.

name: Gulf eVTOL — UAE vs Qatar compared
meta_description: Compares the UAE eVTOL programme (Joby S4 piloted, Dubai 2026 launch) and the Qatar eVTOL programme (EHang EH216-S pilotless, Doha trial Nov 2025).

name: Joby S4 Hybrid-Electric Demonstrator
meta_description: Joby S4-T hybrid-electric demonstrator: first flight 7 November 2025, Marina California. Defense-focused; no UAE deployment announced. Sources verified.

name: Joby S4 (UAE Operations)
meta_description: Joby S4 in UAE service: all-electric eVTOL flown in Dubai since June 2025, first UAE point-to-point flight on 9 November 2025. Specs, milestones, sources.

name: Joby vs Archer UAE exclusivity — explained
meta_description: Joby holds a 6-year exclusive air-taxi agreement with RTA Dubai (Feb 2024). Archer operates from Abu Dhabi via ADIO and Falcon Aviation. How both coexist.

name: Lilium Jet — Saudia Group Sales Agreement
meta_description: Saudia and Lilium signed a binding sales agreement on 18 July 2024 for up to 100 Lilium Jets. Lilium filed final insolvency 21 February 2025; prototypes scrapped April 2026. Contract orphaned.

name: Margham Flight Test Facility
meta_description: Joby Aviation's UAE eVTOL flight test site at Margham, Dubai. Site of the first piloted point-to-point eVTOL flight in the UAE on 9 November 2025.

name: Margham → Al Maktoum International (DWC)
meta_description: Joby flew the UAE's first piloted point-to-point eVTOL route on 9 November 2025: 17 minutes from Margham flight test facility to DWC. Sources verified.

name: Margham → Al Maktoum International (DWC)
meta_description: The Joby S4 completed the first electric-air-taxi point-to-point flight in the UAE on 9 November 2025, flying piloted from Margham to Al Maktoum International (DWC) in 17 minutes.

name: Palm Jumeirah Vertiport at Atlantis the Royal
meta_description: Palm Jumeirah Vertiport at Atlantis the Royal, named by Joby and the RTA on 17 November 2025. Construction set to begin in months following Skyports' 16 April 2026 update.

name: Roads and Transport Authority — Dubai
meta_description: RTA Dubai oversees the Emirate's eVTOL air-taxi network. Holds 6-year exclusive agreement with Joby (Feb 2024) and Skyports vertiport contract.

name: Skyports Infrastructure
meta_description: Skyports Infrastructure: London-based vertiport developer, exclusive builder of Dubai's Joby/RTA vertiport network. VDX technically complete April 2026.

name: The Helicopter Company (THC)
meta_description: The Helicopter Company (THC) is a Saudi Public Investment Fund subsidiary. Signed MoUs with Archer Aviation and Joby Aviation in November 2025 for Saudi eVTOL sandbox testing. CEO Captain Arnaud Martinez.

name: Volocopter NEOM Flight & $175M Investment
meta_description: NEOM invested $175M in Volocopter (Nov 2022) with 15-aircraft order and GACA-authorized flight 21 June 2023. Volocopter filed insolvency 26 Dec 2024; acquired by Wanfeng/Diamond Aircraft March 2025 for €10M.

name: Volocopter VoloCity (UAE History)
meta_description: Volocopter VoloCity UAE history: world-first autonomous air taxi flight in Dubai 25 September 2017. Programme ended after Volocopter insolvency December 2024.

name: Zayed International (AUH) Vertiport
meta_description: AUH Vertiport at Zayed International Airport is under construction as the first node of Abu Dhabi's 10-vertiport advanced air mobility network. Partnership between Abu Dhabi Airports, Skyports Infrastructure, and ADIO.

name: BETA Technologies, Inc.
meta_description: BETA Technologies supplies eVTOL charging hardware to Abu Dhabi Airports. Its first Charge Cube is commissioned at Al Bateen Executive Airport, Abu Dhabi.

name: Eve Air Mobility
meta_description: Eve Air Mobility's UAE record: a 2022 Falcon Aviation letter of intent for up to 35 eVTOLs and a 2023 Kookiejar Urban ATM deal. No UAE operations to date.

name: REGENT Craft, Inc.
meta_description: REGENT Craft plans Abu Dhabi seaglider manufacturing with the Strategic Development Fund. Seagliders are maritime wing-in-ground craft, not eVTOL aircraft.

name: TCab Tech (Shanghai Time Technology Co.)
meta_description: TCab Tech's UAE activity is an MoU with Abu Dhabi's Autocraft for up to 350 E20 eVTOLs. No UAE flights, no facility and no GCAA approval are on record.

name: Vertical Aerospace
meta_description: UK-based Vertical Aerospace has no documented UAE presence - no order, vertiport or GCAA agreement. Its only Gulf activity is a set of Saudi MoUs from 2026.

name: VPorts
meta_description: VPorts signed a 2022 agreement with the UAE GCAA and Dubai South for a 37,000 sqm advanced air mobility integrator centre. No primary evidence it was built.
